BiblicalUsage: In Aramaic this is the word for 'we', and it shows up in the mouths of faithful men: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego answer the king, 'we are not careful to answer thee in this matter,' and the builders of the temple answer their accusers, 'We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth.' Both times the 'we' is a confession — we belong to God, whatever the king says.
TheologicalSignificance: One small word for 'we' carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the stand it takes — we are God's servants, and we will not bow.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
